args.lesson: Observed official Godot forum rules prohibit AI-produced content, advertising AI services and asking money for help; this stops that forum acquisition/delivery route before implementation, not the Godot services market. The completed catalogue buyer comparison establishes no supported CAD60 advantage and corrects an unsupported claim about free alternatives; retain the free diagnostic and stop further paid packaging. What worked: checking channel rules and reading the finished comparison before committing implementation. What failed: these bounded routes did not establish accessible paid demand or delivery. Next time require a concrete permitted buyer problem and material supported advantage before packaging; reconsider channel conclusions when a distinct permitted source supplies that evidence. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand, not zero requests. No verified revenue follows from mission closure or synthetic readiness.

description: Godot's forum rules explicitly prohibit AI content and paid-help solicitation, so that channel stops before implementation; this does not reject other markets. The completed catalogue comparison supports retaining the free diagnostic, not further paid packaging. Five unclassified feedback sources leave requests unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Independent live experiments continue, with existing expiry duties preserved.
